qualifications: The released data span about 1.15 square degrees in Orion A, including M42, M43 and NGC1977; the bounding raster is larger than the valid observed footprint.
The released cube has an 18 arcsecond beam. The paper also discusses finer native instrumental resolution; do not conflate these.
Apply the integer BLANK value before BSCALE/BZERO. Full voxel validity and noise have not been inspected.
